g1-implement.title: Class-grain time-ledger + fingerprint core: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for the PURE class-grain time-ledger core. Deliver src/physics/utilization/class_ledger.py: (a) per-segment transit-time computation dt=ds/v_avg over a SegmentMap's segments given a lap's (distance_m, speed) profile; (b) aggregation to per-CLASS TIME-shares over the (2+k) class vocabulary = {straight, braking_zone} as hard seg_type classes + k corner-severity classes distributed by SOFT severity_membership (time-shares sum to the lap); (c) per-class ABSOLUTE deficits (speed m/s AND transit-time s) given v_ideal + v_real resampled on a shared grid + the SegmentMap. REUSE SegmentMap.segment_of/severity_membership and driver_utility_observable's resample discipline; NEVER a v_real/v_ideal ratio (anti-circularity). RULING (design-it-twice, settled/measured): attribution uses a SINGLE (n, 2+k) class-weight matrix W = hstack([seg_type one-hot {STRAIGHT, BRAKING_ZONE}, severity_membership]); every class reduction is Wᵀ·(segment quantity) — hard where the map is hard (seg_type), soft where it is soft (k severity columns). Assert each W row sums to 1 before reducing (construction invariant). Do NOT argmax-collapse the severity membership (a hard argmax makes the GATING jackknife measure quantization noise); an argmax 'dominant class' view, if wanted, is a derived diagnostic over W, never the attribution mechanism. Author tests/unit/physics/test_class_ledger.py: deficits-sum-to-lap construction check, class time-shares sum to lap, W-row-sums-to-1 guard, soft-membership weighting on synthetic fixtures, grep-verified no ratio. Dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g4-implement.title: Season-capable build CLI + bounded validation + jackknife attribution robustness: implement
g4-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for the season-capable build pipeline + bounded validation. Deliver scripts/build_class_utilization_observables.py: a resumable, idempotent, SEASON-CAPABLE CLI (mirror the #628 build_driver_utility_observables.py structure) composing g1/g2/g3 to persist reference-lap products + per-driver per-class observables to the OWN db. Then RUN it on a BOUNDED, representative slice (a small circuit set + both constructors' drivers, one session each -- NOT the full season; the full-season run is #670/Wave 6). Compute the GATING attribution-robustness check: a DELETE-d / BLOCK JACKKNIFE over derivation laps (NOT drop-one -- drop-one over a ~200-lap pool has near-zero boundary leverage). Drop a driver-block or a random lap-block per replicate, with a STATED, FIXED replicate budget (B ~ 20-50); the PERTURBATION under test is SegmentMap BOUNDARY jitter (re-derive boundaries in-memory from the reduced pool, re-attribute per-class deficits against the SAME fixed v_ideal/v_real profiles -- no session reload), and report per-class deficit STABILITY. This is an INSTRUMENT, NOT a hard pass/fail gate (allocation-not-gating; '2σ is a reference not a gate'): REPORT the stability numbers; anchor any comparison to the EXISTING frozen boundary-drift scale MAP_STABILITY_DRIFT_M -- mint NO new literal acceptance band (if a hard band is ever truly needed it is a FLOAT to the Admiral for a new F12 set, never an inline literal). REQUIRED POSITIVE CONTROL: inject a synthetic lap with a KNOWN misattributed deficit (a corner deficit deliberately shifted into a straight class) and confirm the robustness statistic FLAGS it above the reported band -- a measured-null is a COMPLETE deliverable ONLY if the positive control fired (proves the instrument can detect the failure it exists to detect). Budget the op-count against the <10 min bound BEFORE running; if longer, OS-detach + state-note first per debt #650/#648. Anti-circularity note to record: the SCORING ceiling is the strictly_pre car prior (excludes the target round); the field reference lap only PLACES boundaries, it does not score. Write a validation report to .agent-work/664-reference-laps/artifacts/jackknife_attribution.json (+ a short .md). deficits-sum-to-lap is a CONSTRUCTION check, labelled as such; attribution robustness (with its positive control) is the SUBSTANTIVE gate. A measured-null/weak-attribution result is a COMPLETE deliverable (no frame-kill). Author tests/unit/physics/test_build_class_utilization_observables.py (CLI smoke on synthetic fixtures; temp DB only). Dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent. Wait for and integrate the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
